Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Listen to this. An Asian woman and an African American woman were driving to the restaurant but got into a fender bender on their way there. This resulted in a yelling match in the middle of the road. The African American woman got out of the car and started yelling at the other driver while the Asian woman sat back embarrassed. Who was yelling?
A. The African American woman
B. The Asian woman
C. Not enough information
